europe_now.title: Critical Cyber-Security Update
europe_now.summary: Websites across Europe experienced outages following the issuance of a critical cyber-security update. The incident impacts digital infrastructure across multiple regions.

sources.headline: Websites taken down across Europe as critical cyber-security update issued

europe_now.title: European Parliament Offices Searched
europe_now.summary: European prosecutors conducted searches at the European Parliament offices of the far-right Patriots bloc amid an ongoing graft probe. The investigation centers on potential financial mismanagement of European Union funds.

sources.headline: Prosecutors search European Parliament offices of far-right Patriots bloc in graft probe

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Engagement and Ukraine Negotiations
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky proposed freezing the front line with Russia as an initial step toward prospective peace talks. Meanwhile, US special envoy Steve Witkoff held discussions in Russia concerning regional developments.

sources.headline: Zelensky proposes freezing front with Russia as first step to peace talks
Ukraine talks: US envoy meets Vladimir Putin in Russia

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest and Political Tensions in France
top_stories.summary: French authorities continue to address nationwide riots and civil unrest as the country prepares for further protests over the weekend. President Emmanuel Macron criticized foreign commentary regarding the domestic disturbances.
